normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only feeds the stake flow and has no independent identity.
The director address parameter is just the reward-account key resolved to msg.sender.
The epoch parameter is only used to index rewardEarned during claimable computation.
The checkpointEpochId parameter exists solely to parameterize manual epoch initialization.
previousBalance is a transient snapshot of the staker balance captured inside stake/withdraw.
claimable is a temporary computed value consumed only by reward removal.
currentEpoch is a cached index used only for reward accrual bookkeeping.
totalEarned is a transient sum used only to reset startEpoch after a full claim.
